dos.text: Set selectable before listening for select, onClick returns early when it is false so the event never fires.

Set title whenever you set selectable, render() suppresses the component's own data-l10n-id="moz-five-star-rating" as soon as either is truthy, leaving the role="img" wrapper with no accessible name if title is empty.
Read the new value from the select event's detail.rating or from the reflected rating attribute, onClick assigns this.rating before dispatching.

donts.text: Don't listen for select on an ancestor, the CustomEvent is dispatched without bubbles or composed, so it only fires on the moz-five-star element itself.

Don't expect a selectable widget to produce the half values it can display, getStars() rounds to the nearest half for rendering but onClick reads the star's rating attribute with parseInt, so a click always yields a whole number.
Don't treat selectable as keyboard accessible, the stars are plain <span>s with a click handler and no tabindex or button role, so they can only be operated with a pointer.
